description: This file provides a utility function `ping_host` to check the reachability of an IPv4 address. It attempts to use the `pythonping` library if available, otherwise falls back to system `ping` command, supporting different OS behaviors.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,str] ping_host(ip_address: str, timeout_ms: int = 1000, count: int = 1)
methods.description: Pings an IPv4 address to check if it is reachable. Returns a tuple with the status ('online' or 'offline'), timestamp in ISO format, and an error message if any.

ctags.name: ping_host
ctags.pattern: /^def ping_host(ip_address: str, timeout_ms: int = 1000, count: int = 1) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:$/
